title: DSPy Retrieval Modules
summary: This module provides various components for integrating retrieval mechanisms into DSPy programs, including local ColBERTv2 indexing, reranking, and connectors for external vector databases like Databricks Vector Search and Weaviate. It defines the core `Retrieve` primitive for abstracting document retrieval.

nodes.label: Manage Local ColBERTv2 Index
nodes.title: Local ColBERTv2 Retriever
nodes.description: Builds and searches a local ColBERTv2 index from a collection of passages, enabling efficient retrieval of relevant documents based on a given query.

nodes.label: Wrap ColBERTv2 GET Call
nodes.title: ColBERTv2 GET Wrapper
nodes.description: A thin wrapper function that facilitates making GET requests to a remote ColBERTv2 service, abstracting the underlying HTTP communication details.

nodes.label: Wrap ColBERTv2 POST Call
nodes.title: ColBERTv2 POST Wrapper
nodes.description: A thin wrapper function that facilitates making POST requests to a remote ColBERTv2 service, abstracting the underlying HTTP communication details.

nodes.label: Rerank Passages with ColBERTv2
nodes.title: Local ColBERTv2 Reranker
nodes.description: Reranks an existing list of passages based on their semantic relevance to a query using a local ColBERTv2 model, improving retrieval quality.

nodes.label: Query Remote ColBERTv2 Endpoint
nodes.title: Remote ColBERTv2 Client
nodes.description: Provides an interface to interact with a remote ColBERTv2 service, sending queries and receiving top-k passages via HTTP GET or POST requests.

nodes.label: Retrieve from Databricks Vector Search
nodes.title: Databricks Retriever Module
nodes.description: Integrates with Databricks Mosaic AI Vector Search to retrieve relevant documents. It supports both text and vector queries and handles authentication.

nodes.label: Retrieve Embeddings with Scores
nodes.title: Scored Embeddings Retriever
nodes.description: Extends a base embeddings retriever to return similarity scores alongside passages and their indices, enabling advanced filtering and re-ranking strategies.

nodes.label: Execute Configured Retrieval
nodes.title: DSPy Core Retrieve Primitive
nodes.description: The central DSPy primitive for retrieval. It delegates the actual search operation to the globally configured retrieval module (`dspy.settings.rm`) and formats the results.

nodes.label: Format Passages to Prediction
nodes.title: Passage Formatting Utility
nodes.description: A utility function designed to transform a list of passage dictionaries into a standardized `dspy.Prediction` object, suitable for DSPy programs.

nodes.label: Retrieve from Weaviate Database
nodes.title: Weaviate Retriever Module
nodes.description: Connects to a Weaviate vector database to perform hybrid searches, retrieving top-k passages relevant to a given query using either v3 or v4 clients.

nodes.label: ColBERTv2 Library
nodes.title: ColBERTv2 Library
nodes.description: The external `colbert-ai` Python library, providing core functionalities for local ColBERTv2 indexing, retrieval, and reranking.

nodes.label: Databricks Vector Search Service
nodes.title: Databricks Vector Search
nodes.description: The external Databricks Mosaic AI Vector Search service, a cloud-based vector database for performing similarity searches on large datasets.

nodes.label: Weaviate Vector Database
nodes.title: Weaviate Database
nodes.description: An external open-source vector database used for storing, indexing, and retrieving vector embeddings and associated data.

nodes.label: DSPy Prediction Object
nodes.title: DSPy Prediction
nodes.description: A standard DSPy data structure used to encapsulate the output of a module, typically containing retrieved passages or generated text.

nodes.label: DSPy Global Retriever Configuration
nodes.title: DSPy Global RM
nodes.description: The global configuration point in DSPy (`dspy.settings.rm`) where a specific retrieval module is registered for use by `dspy.Retrieve`.

groups.label: ColBERTv2 Integration
groups.title: ColBERTv2 Retrieval & Reranking
groups.description: Components for integrating ColBERTv2, including local indexing, retrieval, reranking, and interaction with remote ColBERTv2 services.

groups.label: External Vector Database Connectors
groups.title: Connectors for Vector Databases
groups.description: Modules providing interfaces to external vector search services like Databricks Vector Search and Weaviate.

groups.label: DSPy Core Retrieval Primitives
groups.title: DSPy Retrieval Abstractions
groups.description: The fundamental DSPy components for defining and executing retrieval operations, including the main `Retrieve` primitive and specialized embeddings retrieval.
